reviews.comment: Wouldn't let many students ask questions but kept interrupting the speaker to grill them with questions (that the speaker already explained) because he didn't pay attention, and he wouldn't even let them answer. His quizzes are SO detailed, yet he doesn't even care to understand the presentation himself.

The kind of professor who makes you question the tenure system. Contradicts himself every 10 minutes and somehow lacks the self-awareness to notice. Sets rules exclusively for others. One star is generous.

Enforces 'no questions till the end' by interrupting you, then asks one himself minutes later. A walking contradiction with zero self-awareness. His SO must count down the minutes until he's gone. Save yourself.
When you see this please please run! The worst professor I ever had!
He shut down my laptop in the middle of class and threatened to kick me out of the university if I ever used my laptop again. I was just trying to submit the homework.... Never take again. EVER!!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This teacher is so insanely bad at grading; it's genuinely so frustrating. He might be a good lecturer or whatever, not like it matters since his quizzes are kinda hard sometimes, and just the amount of strictness from him is just so incredibly unwarranted. Be penalized on your work and effort, not on how you submit your work.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor wouldn't let me retake a quiz I missed due to a valid excused absence. He said it's not fair for me to take the quiz after everybody else so he gave me a zero and gave me no alternative to take the quiz. I suggested taking it during office hours and he said no I can't take it at all. Horrible professor.

Weekly quizzes, very difficult; avg 60-70% after curve. Homework is long and tedious. No exams/final. Confusing/boring math heavy lectures. Paranoid about cheating, phones and laptops not allowed in lecture, except for notes, will stop lecture to close a student's laptop. Likes class participation, friendly to students who participate in lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I remember reading one of the reviews that called him bipolar, and boy they weren't kidding. The most interesting (in a negative way) professor out there. Glad this semester was over. This guy has bigger problems in his life.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is super knowledgeable about data science and truly does want students to learn. He gets upset with students that don't respect him. As long as you somewhat pay attention in class he will like you. The quizzes are really hard but he drops your lowest 4 quizzes and has a big curve. The four homeworks  are relatively easy, just take a few hours.

His regular quizzes are quite bad because they are loosely tied to lecture material and have weird policies such as short time, starting immediately when the class starts, and not letting you click around. He contradicts himself and isn't immediately open to feedback from students, but he is a caring professor and shows leniency where it counts.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He seems more passionate about tormenting students than imparting knowledge. I believe he'd be better suited for a career as a prison guard.
The worst professor I've encountered. The workload is overwhelming, and he is difficult to get along with.

Mandatory lecture at the end of the semester to check if you used AI for reports. Everyone has to come and he will give a 20 minutes lecture. Then you write the reports on site with lockdown software. He then comprehension the text you wrote on-site with your previous reports to decide whether you used AI.
The worst professor ever.

Easily one of the worst professors in the CSCE department. Quizzes are unreasonably hard (averages in the 30s) and when he asks for our feedback, he doesn't incorporate it. In general has a very mean demeanor to him and makes the learning a chore and not something to look forward to, which sucks considering the content itself is extremely useful.

Definitely the hitler of the CSCE department. Lectures are pretty good and concise and he knows what he's talking about but treats students like high school students. Quizzes are so variable and he doesn't have a good attitude at all. Homeworks are good content but so tedious writing it all up to fit the requirements. Take another elective

Worst professor ever. I love everything else in TAMU, but he is a complete nightmare.

It is a 1 credit course, but the workload is even harder than those 3 credits courses. You will spend several hours to write the report and still get a 0/1 or 0.5/1. I will never attend any course given by him again.
worst professor ever
Not a good professor.

One of the worst classes I have taken here.
Too much work for a single-credit course.
He wants you to write a 1-1.5 page report but the grade will be solely based on the critique section.
No feedback on reports. 
Has quite an ego.

He is terrible, TERRIBLE. Makes an easy 1 credit class, that should be enjoyable into a difficult and awkward experience. A&M knows what they are doing by assigning him to this class, anything else would be a nightmare
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Extremely rude, bipolar. Avoid if possible
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bipolar. Him, this class, the assignments. Lectures were actually really good and informative. Homeworks were absolutely reasonable (not easy but appropriate). The weekly quizzes were difficult but were curved. Took a LOT of feedback and adjusted the course as such.

Ignore the other reviews for this class; it just consists of companies talking about some C.S. related research or topic, with Ricardo only speaking to introduce the guests.  Overall, the class was pretty interesting, and many of the talks were relevant.  Grading criteria is clear, and Ricardo did a fine job.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is bad, but it's not Ricardo's fault.  The class consists of one company advertising themselves for an hour, with you having to write a paper summarizing their speech after.  At least for this class, Ricardo does not lecture, so the bad reviews on him aren't relevant for CSCE 481.  The grading criteria was clearly defined.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ricardo is a unique experience. He puts tons of effort into his class and constantly gets feedback from the class to improve it. Quizzes were very difficult and homework was pretty hard too. He forces the class to participate in lectures by gaslighting and picking individuals to answer. If you actively engage throughout the semester, u will succeed

Most eccentric professor. Enthusiastic and charismatic. Has his mean side as well but otherwise he is chill. Not the best at explaining material but good lecturer who can keep an audience. Terrible quizzes where averages were around a 50 for them and the quizzes are 40% of the grade. But curved the class heavily at the end. My 85 was an A.

Not the best professor. Explains the theory in slides during class and quizzes over them but average quiz grades are in the 40s. Doesn't explain application of concepts in coding so the homeworks are pretty much you figuring it out yourself, best to start early. He's open to feedback though and adds extra points since we are all struggling.
Extremely rude

He seems to put bare minimum work into his teaching. He is charismatic, but has bare coursework with little academic virtue. He kinda comes off as a con-man, which is definitely a first in the classroom.

Easily the worst professor at A&M. His attitude toward students and guest speakers was shocking. He didn't hesitate to be rude or even shout for minor things, which made the class extremely uncomfortable. Honestly, he made an easy course very stressful because of his unprofessionalism. Would ask anybody to think twice before taking class with him.

The course was very easy and doable. However, the professor's attitude was very unpleasant and he is very egotistical. Highly recommend taking another professor and avoid taking his courses, being a TA/RA under him or working with him at any capacity
The course itself is easy and straightforward. Given the opportunity please take another professor for CSCE681.  He is very difficult to deal with.

I was given an offer from him as a graduate student, and as I was worried he was a horrible guy from these comments, I reached out to other faculty members. The other guy went and ratted me out, which caused Ricardo to tell me he did not want me in his lab. Thank god I escaped his wrath :) Man, do not contact this guy, he's AWFUL.
Ignorant and stubborn, doesn't care about students

Beginning of the semester was rough. He was strict and was very rude to one of the presenters. However, after complaints by the department head, he changed the course structure to be more lenient and he improved as a person. Getting an A is so easy, you just watch lectures and submit a report, just make sure to read the announcements.

He isn't as bad as his reviews make it out to be. If you read his announcements of canvas, something which a lot of my classmates did not, and do your assignments in a timely manner 481 with Ricardo is a breeze. Yes he was very rude at the start of the semester, but since he changed, the class was actually pretty good, but more importantly, easy.
Enough said. Horrible professor.

He sucked at the beginning of the semester, hence why he was review bombed. He did provide us ample opportunities to provide feedback, which he listened to and changed the course to reflect. Grading scale is easy: out of the 13 lectures we had, we had to complete assignments for 12 of them to get an A. One choice to get credit is a 150 word paper

During two seminars at the semesters start, he was pretty rude to the presenters. After that, he listened to some of the backlash he got, and changed the class for the better (camera is optional, more leeway for attendance, more makeup assignments etc.). Willingness to improve is important, and the review bombing doesn't reflect that.
I have never seen anyone be so needlessly rude. Maybe he is going through tough times. I think he should take a leave of absence.
Online seminar. I got kicked out of the zoom meeting literally for no reason, so I didn't get attendance credit that day.
He was viscous and rude to the presenters and has watches like a hawk. The strangest things will get you kicked and he is vigilant to watch out for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Most disrespectful professor I have ever had. Disrupts and CRITICIZES presenters from companies in the middle of their presentation. Absolutely ridiculous and embarrassing for the students to have to witness and for the university.

I had to stretch during the meeting because of back pain, went off camera for 1 minute, and got kicked out of the class. He expects us to tell him whenever we go to the restroom in an online class???. Missing 2 zoom sessions is automatically B. Is also super rude to students.

Try your best to get through the cringe in lectures when he talks over the industry presenters as they present! They were talking over the preferences of the audience, and he really said "where is the presentation? you're just talking to each other", after not paying attention for 30 mins. On top of this, has authoritarian zoom rules.

Hosts the easiest class in the world but somehow makes it the worst experience. You aren't allowed to go to the bathroom, walk, or even STRETCH in the zoom call, otherwise he kicks you. I don't even know how he's overseeing all 400 students to identify the absolute criminals doing such heinous acts such as stretching. Based i guess

Rude professor. Presenters tried to have a little fun by doing an interactive portion and he started yelling at them as if they were kids slacking off or something. Also kicked everyone out of zoom for getting a sip of water.

Literally one of the rudest professors I've ever had. This class has company speakers and every lecture without fail he was rude and dismisses to the presenters, talking over their presentations, restricting questions by turning off the chat etc.
This is just a 1hr class so it doesn't matter, but I would never take an actual credit class with him.

This has to be the most disrespectful and awful professor in all of Texas A&M. I'm not sure who he thinks he is. Extremely rude not only to students but also to guest speakers from companies. Gives Texas A&M a terrible reputation. He should not be employed. Extremely unfair to students as well. A disgrace to the university.

The seminar is very simple with only 1 easy grade a week, and I'll try to give the professor the benefit of the doubt as it's only been a few weeks, but he has on multiple occasions been disrespectful to presenters from guest companies for no good reason, and his rules in regards to Zoom seem very extreme and unfair to the students.

Awful professor. I turned off my Zoom camera for 2 minutes and he removed me from the call with no way to rejoin. I was working on my superglides but he told me aim is more important than movement. Cringe and awful professor.

Horrible professor! He is a poor representative for the school. He talks down to students for asking reasonable questions. He talks down to industry experts and recruiters. Meta tried to collect resumes and he forced them to take down the link to submit them. He disabled the chat, misnamed the companies, and disrespected the presenters.

very rude when presenters from different companies come and talk. Interrupts their presentations and does not treat them well. Also turns off chat. real pos imo. He is making A&M students look bad and recruiters gonna second guess coming back to present if he keeps up bs like this.

This professor is so unbelievably rude to speakers. He is embarrassing us as students and preventing us from networking with the companies as we are supposed to. The reports are easy, but this professor is insufferable during these presentations, and frequently interrupts the speakers.

I'm currently in week 3 in his class. I don't need to finish this class to solidify my rating. This man is mean for the sake of being mean. The worst part is that he isn't just mean to students, he's mean to the recruiters who are invited to come talk about their company. He's an awful professor who adds nothing to my career development experience.

Made me feel embarrassed to be a student at TAMU. He was extremely rude to the companies that would come to give presentations to get us excited about their company. The presenters wanted to create an engaging and fun, interactive presentation, but he wouldn't allow them to do so. This makes TAMU look bad in the eyes of these companies.

He is is extremely rude and lacks decency to show some sort of kindness and respect to other individuals. He interrupts presenters and consistently ruins the engagement with the course. The class is easy and straightforward, but Dr. Gutierrez-Osuna just makes the experience such a hassle. Also, it appears as if he has a "distaste" for a chat box.

Super negative and rude professor. He went as far as interrupting a speaker in the middle of a talk, just to make the class fill out course evaluations, which could be done on our own time. He also makes very silly rules for the class. Regardless this class is very easy as long as you summarize the seminar sessions and give your opinion on them.

He made our seminar class awkward and more time-consuming than it needed to be. It was more difficult to engage with the speakers because we constantly had to change our reports to fit the new style for that week.

For such an easy class, the prof made it a horrible experience. He was always rude to both the students and presenters. Instead of coming to class with a positive attitude he was always negative and brought down the mood. Either way its an easy A as long as you show up and do the assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: During every seminar, he is so picky about what goes on in the chat. No LOLs or LMAOs allowed. He thinks its too distracting and does not want students to be off topic. Class was pretty straightforward other than that.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Ricardo "OscarTomato" Gutierrez-Osuna is one of the best professors here at Texas A&M. He's almost like a egg. Hard shell on the outside but a real softie on the inside. He's frankly very good at teaching. I think without him I wouldn't have learned nearly as much in his class. Go Tomato!

Avoid at all costs. Professor Ricardo seems to enjoy putting down his students and rarely ever provides any positive enforcement. There is a tremendous amount of work as is typical with this course but it is made much more brutal by a professor that seems to want to make the experience worse for everyone.

He is very impatient when answering student's questions. A&M has many good professors. He is the one that completely disappoints me. I feel that he enjoys bullying students. He hardly shows any kindness to the students.

He is an incredibly impatient and ill-tempered professor. On being asked a question, he tries hard to find something in it to ridicule you. It is unfortunate how easily he gets frustrated. I wish someone can tell him that all students aren't as stupid as he thinks them to be, and also that doing some yoga may help with his temper.
This is a very bad professor. He is very mean to the students. He is notorious in this department. Stay away from him!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor treats students with hatred and shows zero patience in class. His lab students are treated like slaves! I've met bad professors but nothing compared to this one. Stay away!!!
Pathetic teacher for CSCE681. Try avoiding him.

I have to mention that one time I saw a student asking professor questions about homework before lecture and got totally ignored, treating him like nonexistence and he had to go back to his seat feeling humuliating. Professor acts like he is a "king" over the class. This is so not cool and unrespectful for student.

Since he's very clear about criteria, you won't get much slack if you don't meet it. His style is pretty aggressive, but once you realize he doesn't hate you, you realize he's actually a genius and a great teacher. Unless you have trouble understanding Spanish accents or can't keep up with people who talk really fast, I recommend him highly.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Worst "professor" I have met in my life, at least till now. He is arrogant and stubborn and simply no chance to argue with him. His course is boring and lots of boring jokes if you find any good. He tends to give his lab students an A even though they actually should get a C. Nevertheless, he acts tough and mean towards his lab students. Stay away.
One of the best profs in the University. His reputation as one of the most difficult is well earned - but you will learn something AND enjoy class.
Will hold you hostage with an I for semsters to come
